name: Telekinetic
description:
You learn to move things with your mind, granting you the following benefits:
- As an action, you may pick up or move objects from up to 60 ft. away. The object can not be heavier than 10 lbs.
- As a Minor Action, you can try to telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do so, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 12 + your proficiency bonus) or be moved 5 feet towards you, away from you, or knocked Prone. A creature can willingly fail this save.
